scope: HITL-001 candidate-bound pending-Approval lifecycle using the disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO and private Temporal test services.

observations.pending_phase: A waiting Approval keeps its Turn non-terminal without starting a model invocation and remains observable across the public runtime-process restart path.
observations.limitations: Broker setup is private test setup; no model provider, Workspace service, browser, Stack, protected sandbox, Firecracker, or Linux/KVM is claimed.

redaction: No IDs, tokens, descriptors, grants, DSNs, object-store credentials, inputs, or endpoints are retained.
